title: Change-Order Fee on Window Contracts
content:
# Change-Order Fee on Window Contracts

Window Replacement Contracts estimating fee statement.

**The fee.** The change-order fee is figured for the most recent customer change order on the contract, that is every customer change-order line written on the latest date that carries customer change-order lines; an oversize surcharge line is never a customer change-order line. The change-order fee is the series change-order fee of the contract's series, from the change-order allowances card, rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Identifying the change order

| Lines on the contract's history | Belongs to the most recent customer change order? |
|---|---|
| Option or added-opening lines written on the latest such date | Yes, all of them together |
| Option or added-opening lines written on an earlier date | No |
| An oversize surcharge line, on any date | No, never a customer change-order line |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A contract carries customer change-order lines dated 2031-09-03 and 2031-10-14, and an oversize surcharge line dated 2031-11-02. The most recent customer change order is the lines dated 2031-10-14. In a series with a hypothetical change-order fee of $90, the fee comes to $90.00.
